title: Routing table, default gateway and metrics

videos.script: A router does not know the network. It knows a table, and it asks that table once for every packet. {{table}} In this lesson you will read one, line by line. You start with a router that knows only its own cables, and watch it refuse a packet for a network one cable away. {{refuse}} Then comes a default route, the line that catches everything else. {{default}} Then two routes that both contain the same address, and the rule that picks one: the longest prefix wins. Traceroute shows the packets taking the path the rule predicts. {{longest}} Then two routes to the same place, a preferred one and a backup. You will pull a cable and watch the traffic move. {{metric}} And last, the same route from two sources. A routing suite keeps both, and decides which one to believe. {{distance}} Everything runs in this course's lab, so every line on the screen is one the routers printed. {{lab}}
